skills.skill_desc:
Gloo's skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Sticky</font> to enemies on hit, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6s (up to 5 stacks).
Each <font color="a6aafb">Sticky</font> stack on an attacker reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 3%.

Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing 80<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.
A <font color="a6aafb">Goo</font> is left at the end location, which explodes after 3s, dealing 230<font color="26e407"> (+11% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and immobilizing them for 0.6s.
Touching the <font color="a6aafb">Goo</font> detonates it immediately and resets this skill's cooldown. Gloo also recovers 2.5% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if it hits an enemy hero).

Gloo splits into <font color="a6aafb">Goos</font>, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5s. For the next 4s, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals 80<font color="62f8fe"> (+15% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.25s to enemies it touches.
If this skill hits a <font color="a6aafb">Goo</font>, Gloo charges toward it, dragging enemies in its path along for a distance.

Unlocked when an enemy hero reaches max <font color="a6aafb">Sticky</font> stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target for up to 9s, recovering 20% <font color="26e407"><1005></font>.

While attached, Gloo's Basic Attacks deal 30<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="26e407"> (+6% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, and it transfers 60% of the damage it takes (excluding Turret damage) to the host. If the host dies while Gloo is attached, this skill's cooldown is reduced to 5s.
